n91f5589a1f.headline: Fed's Mester heartened by U.S. job rebound in June
n91f5589a1f.summary: Federal Reserve official Loretta Mester expressed optimism about the U.S. labor market following a sharp rebound in job growth in June.
n91f5589a1f.why: Labor market strength influences Federal Reserve monetary policy decisions, impacting interest rates, inflation, and financial markets.
n91f5589a1f.why_moved: Improved labor data reduces concerns about economic slowdown, supporting expectations of continued monetary tightening.

n85e746d49e.headline: Nissan Announces Sales of First Driverless Car to Start in August
n85e746d49e.summary: Nissan Motor said sales in Japan of the world's first mass-produced car with autonomous driving capability will begin in August. The launch marks a commercial step for self-driving vehicles.
n85e746d49e.why: Nissan is a major Japanese automaker, and autonomous driving is a key technology race among carmakers. Early commercial launches can influence competitive positioning and investor expectations.
